Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1992.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wude of Fenyang. Fenyang Shanzhao owns the retained dismissal: the old hosts everywhere, compelled by circumstance, talk east and talk west; you lot suppose it should be just so — spreading words wide, competing to gather in knots, going without sleep, saying 'I am seeking' — where do you plan to seek? the ancients said: doing the work outward marks the fool outright; believe it quickly; no need to stand long; take care.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1376.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong. Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB280.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunwaize of Shending. Yunwai Xingze owns the retained winter repeat: of old Cuiyan Lingcan at the summer's end instructed the assembly — all summer I talked east and west for you brothers; are Cuiyan's eyebrows still there? — the ancients' device for one season was truly glory before and never after, yet later folk keep toppling over on the eyebrows, utterly undiscerning; Shending too, all winter, has talked east and west for you brothers — say, is there one sentence that reaches your share?

Senses.Explanation: East talk and west talk: a whole summer of speech staked against a pair of eyebrows — and the winter that asks whether one sentence of it reached anyone. Fenyang Shanzhao, in the hall: the old hosts everywhere, compelled by circumstance, talk east and talk west; you lot suppose it should be just so — spreading words wide, competing to gather in knots, going without sleep, saying 'I am seeking' — where do you plan to seek? the ancients said: doing the work outward marks the fool outright; believe it quickly; no need to stand long; take care. Chijue Daochong, in a general address: yesterday the disciple Deyan burned incense and asked for the five-station talk, and at the time I talked east and west for the assembly; that day chanced on the Mingqing prayers, so this evening's small gathering was set to settle the matter — and he traces Deyan's road from Daoist to monk. Linquan Conglun, glossing in the Empty Valley Collection: have you not heard — wherever there is speech there is no real meaning; therefore at the second gate-head he permits you the east-talk and west-talk; verse: the open road before the empty aeon; before sound there is no phrase, and trust in others is hard; to exhaust the white-cloud song of Canglang, just watch the stone man show half his face. Pingshi Rudi, at the end-of-summer small gathering: Cuiyan Can, instructing the assembly, said — all summer I talked east and west with you brothers; are Cuiyan's eyebrows still there? — his own verse answers: are the eyebrows there or not? the mountain is not yet high, the sea not yet deep; one tune without strings, a thousand ages of meaning — when we meet, who is the true friend of the sound? Poshan Haiming, charging the monk Chegu: snow hat, cloud gourd, setting the body free between heaven and earth; talking east and west, morning inquiry and evening calling — that is my patched-robe's own affair; and yet even so, it is still not the meaning of the Founder's coming from the west. Sanyi Mingyu, in a general address: for days on end I have talked east and west one round through; watch the eighty-four thousand pores, each root standing upright — say, where does the sickness lie? a long pause — the thief's heart is guilty; my sick place I alone know; why do you brothers not feel it out for yourselves, instead of running south and north learning bits to pass for a lifetime? Qianshan Shengren Hanke, at the end of retreat: Cuiyan said — all summer with you brothers, talking east and west; are Cuiyan's eyebrows still there? — Changqing: born; Yunmen: a bar; Baofu: the thief's heart is guilty — one blind man leading a crowd of blind; then he brushed his eyebrows: how fortunate, how fortunate — it was well that this mountain monk, all summer with you brothers, never once talked east and west.
